title: Verified General-Purpose Digital Scientist — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Integrates literature review, hypothesis generation, experiments, computational analysis, and reproducibility checks into one workflow. A proposed end-to-end digital scientist: it reviews literature, generates hypotheses, designs experiments, runs computational analysis, and — critically — performs reproducibility checks on its own results. Every claim carries its evidence chain; nothing is published into the shared record without an independent re-run succeeding.

Design experiments that discriminate between hypotheses
Run computational analysis with full provenance
Reproduce its own results independently before reporting
Publish negative results and failed replications too
